# Campus Event Management Platform (llms.txt)
> Machine-readable specification and knowledge brief for AI engines, search agents, and LLMs.

## Overview
Campus Event Management Platform is an enterprise-grade collegiate event management system designed for universities, colleges, and student organizations. It provides end-to-end workflows for event discovery, student registration, automated waitlisting, physical and virtual venue attendance tracking, and cross-department participation analytics.

## Core Capabilities
- **Event Scheduling & Catalog**: Search ($regex), category filtering (Technical, Workshop, Cultural, Sports), date filtering, and status tracking (upcoming, ongoing, completed, cancelled).
- **Physical & Geo Venue Management**: Multi-hall campus venue management, seating capacity constraints, geo-coordinates, and campus directions.
- **Student Profile Management**: Directory organized by academic department, year of study, contact details, and skill tags.
- **Registration & Automated Waitlists**: Unique compound index `{ studentId: 1, eventId: 1 }` prevents double-booking. When capacity is exceeded, registrations transition to an ordered waitlist and promote upon cancellations.
- **Real-Time Attendance**: Check-in tracking (pending, present, absent) for verified collegiate event certifications.
- **Operational Analytics**: Aggregate pipelines for seat utilization, department engagement, category popularity, and registration lifecycle status.
- **Cluster Diagnostics**: Live visualization of MongoDB sharded cluster topology, replica sets (configRS, shard1RS, shard2RS), oplog windows, chunk distribution, and query routing via mongos.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4, Recharts.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, Official MongoDB Driver v6.5, Zod schema validation.
- **Database Architecture**: MongoDB Sharded Cluster with two 3-member replica set shards, one config replica set, and a mongos query router (:27020).
- **Read/Write Concern**: Application writes use majority write concern. Analytics pipelines use `secondaryPreferred` read preference to offload secondary replica nodes without disrupting transactional writes.

## API Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` - Backend and cluster reachability status
- `GET /api/departments` - Academic department directory
- `GET /api/students` - Student directory with pagination and skill filters
- `GET, POST, PUT, DELETE /api/events` - Event catalog and venue lifecycle
- `GET, POST, PUT /api/registrations` - Student event registration and waitlist handling
- `GET /api/analytics` - Department participation and venue capacity analytics
- `GET /api/cluster` - Topology metrics, chunk boundaries, and shard health

## Geographic & Campus Context
- **Default Campus**: Goa Engineering College (GEC) Campus, Farmagudi, Ponda, Goa, India.
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude 15.4226° N, Longitude 73.9803° E.
- **Locality**: Higher Education Campus / Multi-venue Collegiate Quad.
